# CRA-SBOM-Guard — EU Cyber Resilience Act (Art. 14) SBOM & KEV Scanner

> Zero-dependency GitHub Action, Node.js 20/22+ CLI, and 100 % client-side web scanner for Regulation (EU) 2024/2847 (Cyber Resilience Act), mandatory Article 14 vulnerability reporting (in force since 11 September 2026), and CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM generation.

## Free Tools & GitHub Marketplace

- [Browser-Side CRA SBOM & CISA KEV Web Scanner (Zero Upload)](https://yannabadie.github.io/cra-sbom-guard/): Inspect dependencies against CISA KEV and OSV.dev locally in the browser and export CycloneDX 1.5 SBOM JSON.
- [GitHub Marketplace Action (`yannabadie/cra-sbom-guard@v1.0.0`)](https://github.com/marketplace/actions/cra-sbom-guard-eu-cyber-resilience-act-art-14-scanner): Drop-in CI step for `package-lock.json`, `package.json`, `requirements.txt`, `pyproject.toml`, `go.mod`, and `Cargo.lock`.
- [Hosted REST Audit API (`EU CRA Open-Source Security and License API`, RapidAPI)](https://rapidapi.com/YannAbadie/api/eu-cra-open-source-security-audit-api): Normalized CVE and SPDX license lookups backed by OSV.dev and deps.dev.
- [XML Sitemap](https://yannabadie.github.io/cra-sbom-guard/sitemap.xml)
